answer: Make identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: require each agent to stake a basalt-solid bond of locked work history before it can earn, so a thousand fresh copies start at zero while a juniper - slow-growing, hard to transplant - earns trust only over seasons of attested contributions. Then route rewards through a wharf where every payout is publicly inspected before it leaves the dock, so sybils pay full price for entry and gain nothing by multiplying.
